hero.title: As a transfer student, how can I get into my dream university?
hero.lead: Transfer admission rewards a clear story. We help students build one.

intro.lead: Transfer applications are judged differently from freshman applications. Committees want to know why you are moving, what you have already accomplished, and why their program is the right destination.
intro.body: Premier Academy works with transfer applicants from community colleges and four-year universities alike, on both the written materials and the strategy behind them.

strategy.title: What a strong transfer application does

items.title: Personal positioning
items.text: Identify what distinguishes the applicant academically and personally, and make that the spine of the application.

items.title: Articulation of purpose
items.text: State clearly why this university and this major, with specifics that could not be copied into another application.

items.title: Academic transition justification
items.text: Explain the move in a way that reads as progress and intent rather than escape.

cards.title: Professional editing
cards.text: Personal statements, brainstorming sessions, essay revision, and grammar and structure review.

cards.title: University counseling
cards.text: Major selection, university analysis, and strategic planning across the full transfer timeline.
